name: r6k_TaskListLoad
notes: demo task list loader: per record the stored size from a8b_descGetters[kind]()[sub].size; kind 6 sub 1 skipped; task from 0x0008B980; mode 0x64 copies (0x0007F210) and for kind 8 sub 1 moves the top nibble of +0x10 into bits 24..27 with the top byte cleared; mode 0x65 only copies; link index +0x08 cleared and resolved with 0x0007F390(parent) and attached (0x0008B3B0); inserted after the previous task (0x0007F3F0); returns bytes used +0x10 or -1 (bad args / failed task / overrun then 0x0008B400 frees and *out = 0); the failure gotos are written as result = -1 and break and the overrun compare (locals only) is placed after the 0x0007F330 call so cl does not duplicate that call on the failure path

name: r6k_NewGameReset
notes: new game reset: the 25 chapter records get time -1.0 and -1 elsewhere; 0x00413164/0x00413168 = 1; 0x0041316C..0x00413174 = 0; event flag words 0x004133F0..0x00413430 and float 0x0041317C cleared; then 0x0019C1E0 / 0x00049AA0(0x10) / 0x00049B00(3) / 0x00049A40(0 0..4) / 0x000D9BF0 and event flags 0x330 0x338 0x33A 0x33C 0x350 0x35A set; the record loop ends with a signed pointer compare written as an intptr_t compare; modern cl biases the record pointer differently inside the same table 0x00413198 (original pointer at +4 so field offsets -4..0x10; ours at the next record so offsets -0x1C..-8) and stores -1.0f as an immediate (same value)

name: r6k_ActorsUpdate
notes: per-frame update of the 32 actor records at 0x004242C0: model +0x60 to +0x70 and (type not 0x1F) +0x50 to +0x80; script 0x00090560; step 0x000A3AE0; per-kind update table 0x002E40B0[+0x18] unless flag 0x10000; follow the player 0x000A2FB0 while flags 0x300000; except types 0x1D/0x4C/0x95/0xA8..0xAA/0xD7..0xE1/0xF7 (jump table) and unless flag 0x1000 the eight points +0x15C go to the world +0x1DC (0x001ADAF0) and are tested against the scene area (0x00082E50 with 0x000847F0(scene +0x44 id +0x25C) + 0x230) to hide (0x0001D610 clear 0x40000000) or show (0x0001D700 set 0x40000000 unless 0x20000000) the model; then 0x000A3990; ends with 0x000A0FD0(player) and tail 0x000A1020; calls 0x000A3AE0 with ESI=actor and 0x000A3990 with EAX=actor; signed pointer loop end written as an intptr_t compare; modern cl strength-reduces the +0x70 position pointer into a second induction variable starting at 0x00424330 (field +0x70 of record 0 of the same table aa0_slots) where the original recomputes it with lea each iteration; the 8-point loop counts down in the original

name: r6k_ZonesUpdate
notes: per-frame trigger zone test: needs the zone list 0x003ED248 and 0x00086C30; clears the current zone (0x003ED234 = -1 and 0x003ED240 / 0x003ED238 = 0); 0x00087AE0 == 1 sets state 0x003ED21C = 3; Jack's position (0x00420E98 +0x60) with the height from his model node; stops while the distance (0x001B2730) to the last position 0x003ED224 is below 0.0001 (x87 compare order as the original); first used zone accepted by 0x000875E0 becomes current; position remembered; forced zone id 0x003ED23C overrides and is cleared; with a current zone 0x00085390(0) == 1 sets state 3; returns 0; calls 0x000875E0 with ESI=zone EDI=position EBX=last position; the original forms the node address +0x300 and reads +0x74 where modern cl folds both into one +0x374 load (same field)

name: r6k_GimmickSpin
notes: two-record gimmick update (the actor and the next record): step 0 turns its model (0x000C56B0) and adds frame units * 0.1745329 (10 degrees) to the angle +0x84 then wraps it (0x000A35B0); triggered by model hit bits 0x18 / bits 6 while +0x128 is 0 / types 0x50 and 0xFB in chapter 2 stage 4 (0x0041316C 0x00413170) with event flag 0xBA when 0x000A2630(actor 0x1D record / model / point (0 0 0 1)) hits (0x000A42A0(0x1D) result unused as in the original); then clears flags 0x810 and +0x90..+0x9C and copies the position to the second record (+0x2D0) and its model (+0x380 +0x60) and steps on; step 1 0x000A41D0(next 1) and 0x000A41D0(a -1) and 0x000A4740(a 0); modern cl stores the local 1.0f as an immediate (same value)
